messages.subject: [Genabel-announce] ProbABEL v0.4.4 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear user of the GenABEL suite,

On behalf of all contributors I am very happy to announce the release of
v0.4.4. of ProbABEL.
This is a bugfix release (fixing two bugs), and users of the Cox PH
module are strongly advised to upgrade. For users of the linear and
logistic modules nothing has changed.

Please read the full announcement on the GenABEL website at
http://www.genabel.org/node/297.
Updated Debian and Ubuntu packages will be released shortly.

Special thanks go to the people who have contributed to this release,
both via private communication, e-mails to the development mailing list
and our forum: forum user 'mmold', Anne Grotenhuis, Matthias Wuttke,
Luba Pardo and Joris Verkouteren. Thank you all for your input, testing,
bug reporting, etc.!

Questions regarding this release are welcome on our forum:
http://forum.genabel.org. Bugs and feature requests can be reported via
our trackers on R-forge: https://r-forge.r-project.org/tracker/?group_id=505


Best regards,

Lennart.
--
